The '''Great Hall of the Council''' is the ruling palace of the [[Council of Nine]]. It is located in [[Illian]], opposite the [[King's Palace]] across the [[Square of Tammaz]].
==Creation==
The Great Hall of the Council was first created after permission was granted by [[Nicoli Merseneos den Ballin]] to construct a palace on the restriction that it was not to be as large as the King's Palace. These conditions were met - [[Ogier]] constructed a replica of the King's Palace that was identical in every way, save that it was two feet smaller in every dimension.{{ref/book|bwb}}
